overview_description.description: Point is a home equity platform that helps homeowners access equity financing in exchange for a fractional share of the future value of their homes. With a Home Equity Investment, homeowners can eliminate debt, get through periods of financial hardship, and diversify their wealth. For investors, Point provides access to a previously untapped asset class in the residential real estate space.
